CDC BRFSS 2015 · Random Forest

Diabetes Risk Predictor

A Random Forest trained on 183,579 responses to the CDC's 2015 health survey. Answer 21 questions to see the score it gives, which answers drove it, and how people with similar scores actually turned out.

A course project for learning, not a medical tool. A low score does not rule out diabetes and a high score is not a diagnosis. Only a blood test can tell. Your answers never leave your browser.
